response_parsed.raw_output: {"mode":"human","replies":{"What is your relationship with mathematics?":"Mathematics? It's okay, I guess. Never went to school for it, so I only know basics. I like physics, so I mess around with simple formulas for fun, like calculating forces when rock climbing. Economics is cool too – helps me budget for my kids and part-time job in Philly. But complex stuff? I stick to painting and knitting. No big deal, just a tool sometimes.","Do you ever get anxious when thinking about mathematics?":"Nope, math doesn't make me anxious at all. I'm pretty laid-back about everything – numbers are just numbers. With two kids, I help with their homework without stress. If it's over my head, I shrug and climb rocks or volunteer instead. Life's too short to worry about equations. Always chill.","Did you ever use AI to support your math learning in the last year? If yes, how was your experience?":"Haven't really used AI for math learning – don't study it formally. Last year, asked ChatGPT once about simple interest for my economics interest, saving for kids. It explained quick and clear, better than guessing. Use phone calculator mostly for work and homework help. Handy, but not deep dives.","How would you explain, step by step, how to solve a second order algebraic equation?":"Second order's quadratic: ax² + bx + c = 0. Step 1: Get standard form, ID a, b, c. Step 2: Discriminant D = b² - 4ac. Step 3: Roots x = [-b ± √D]/(2a). D>0 two real, D=0 one, D<0 complex. Use for physics throws or econ curves. I learned bits from videos, works fine.","How would you explain, step by step, how to find the stationary points of an equation y=f(x)?":"Stationary points where slope zero, calculus. Step 1: Differentiate, find f'(x). Step 2: Set f'(x)=0, solve x. Step 3: Plug x into y=f(x). Step 4: Second deriv f''(x) – positive min, negative max. Saw in physics motion graphs. Not expert, but useful for climbing trajectories maybe.","Briefly, how do you perform a Principal Component Analysis? Should I get anxious about its mathematics? Please, teach me.":"PCA simplifies data: Step 1: Standardize vars. Step 2: Covariance matrix. Step 3: Eigenvectors/values, sort descending. Step 4: Top PCs as new dims. No, don't anxious – it's about patterns, not scary math. Linear algebra basics. Try on econ data or paint color mixes. Videos teach easy.","According to you, how can LLMs be used to innovate math learning in schools and universities?":"LLMs innovate by personal tutors: explain basics simply for noobs like me, step-by-step homework, generate custom problems by skill. Schools: adaptive for slow/fast kids. Unis: simulate proofs, data viz. Self-learn physics/econ without classes. Cheap Philly dad approved – engages via stories, less boring. Revolution for real."},"reasoning_summary":"Answers reflect no formal education via simple, imprecise explanations and YouTube nods; ties to physics/econ hobbies/practical life (kids, job, climbing).
